title: SkillRet: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Skill Retrieval in LLM Agents
experiment_implication: Reproduce the corrected evaluation and task-trained embedding/reranker baselines.
limitation: Published results are not our measurements; pin dataset, code, model and representation.

title: SkillRouter: Skill Routing for LLM Agents at Scale
experiment_implication: Compare retrieve-then-rerank routing and an independent skill benchmark.
limitation: The current title differs from earlier cached descriptions; do not mix benchmark pools.

title: Skill Retrieval Augmentation for Agentic AI
experiment_implication: Use SRA as the first external retrieval/skill-use benchmark.
limitation: Retrieval, incorporation and execution are different outcomes.

title: Graph-of-Skills: Dependency-Aware Structural Retrieval for Massive Agent Skills
experiment_implication: Test dependency-aware expansion only after a strong flat baseline.
limitation: Graph construction and graph-information budgets are extra experimental factors.

title: When Single-Agent with Skills Replace Multi-Agent Systems and When They Fail
experiment_implication: Motivates catalog-size and hierarchical-selection experiments.
limitation: Not a directly comparable SkillRet leaderboard result.

title: More Skills, Worse Agents? Skill Shadowing Degrades Performance When Expanding Skill Libraries
experiment_implication: Measure overlapping-skill confusion and final selection, not only retrieval.
limitation: An overlap stress set is a separate benchmark slice, not the official overall score.

title: Skill Is Not Document: Query-Conditioned Compatibility for LLM Agent Skill Routing
experiment_implication: Test compatibility-aware skill-set selection; inspect R3-Skill for transfer.
limitation: Compatibility and relevance need separate labels and metrics.

title: Right Family, Wrong Skill: Evaluating Risk Exposure in Agent Skill Retrieval
experiment_implication: Add helpful-versus-risky sibling analysis after quality baselines.
limitation: Do not use oracle family labels as an available routing feature.

title: SkillSight: Calibrating Generic Content Bias for Skill Retrieval
experiment_implication: Test correction of generic/shared skill-content bias.
limitation: Training-free does not mean tuning-free; select coefficients on development data.

title: Skill2Query: Exploiting Skill Structure to Generate Pseudo-Queries for Agent Skill Retrieval
experiment_implication: Build corpus-derived pseudo-query views and separately test query rewriting.
limitation: Index augmentation, model training, and online rewriting must be separate ablations.

title: Field-Aware Agent Skill Retrieval
experiment_implication: Keep name, description and body separate; compare lexical/dense field fusion.
limitation: Reported older SkillRet pool has 6,660 skills and 4,997 queries; not directly comparable to corrected scores.

title: Beyond Top-k Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents
experiment_implication: Test query-conditioned diversity selection against ordinary top-k and MMR.
limitation: Diversity can remove two genuinely required similar skills; monitor completeness.

title: When Synthetic Data Hurts: On Catastrophic Forgetting in Skill Retrieval for LLM Agents
experiment_implication: Require real/OOD checks and replay or anchoring when adapting models.
limitation: In-distribution synthetic gains alone do not establish better generalization.

title: SkillSeek: Revisiting Agent Skill Retrieval at Marketplace Scale
experiment_implication: Compare deterministic retrieval with expensive LLM-mediated selection under matched execution conditions.
limitation: Its SkillsBench conclusions are conditional on the tested pool/backbone/harness.

title: SkillFlow: Scalable and Efficient Agent Skill Retrieval System
experiment_implication: Study staged reranking and escalation as a system design.
limitation: The identifier and title were checked at the primary landing page; benchmark-specific outcomes must stay separate.

title: SkillDAG: Self-Evolving Typed Skill Graphs for LLM Skill Selection at Scale
experiment_implication: Compare typed skill relations with a simpler hierarchy and flat global retrieval.
limitation: Freeze graph updates before the fixed-corpus test; online evolution needs another protocol.

title: SE-GoS: Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills for Skill Library at Scale
experiment_implication: Optional graph-index adaptation experiment.
limitation: Test-time feedback can leak across queries; distinguish frozen and online evaluation.

title: SkillApt: Learning When to Activate Agent Skills from Counterfactual Evidence
experiment_implication: Use matched with-skill/without-skill outcomes for activation research.
limitation: A retrieved relevant skill is not necessarily beneficial or necessary.

title: Organizing, Orchestrating, and Benchmarking Agent Skills at Ecosystem Scale
experiment_implication: AgentSkillOS motivates capability trees and hierarchical routing.
limitation: Keep orchestration/execution outside the core discovery claim.

title: A Comprehensive Survey on Agent Skills: Taxonomy, Techniques, and Applications
experiment_implication: Use as a taxonomy and backward/forward citation-search seed.
limitation: A survey is a discovery source, not experimental evidence that a particular method wins.

title: Agent Skills for Large Language Models: Architecture, Acquisition, Security, and the Path Forward
experiment_implication: Define the scope of procedural agent skills and their lifecycle.
limitation: Do not import broad ecosystem claims as measured SkillRet outcomes.

title: SkillsBench: Benchmarking How Well Agent Skills Work Across Diverse Tasks
experiment_implication: Optional downstream execution check for frozen finalists.
limitation: Different papers use different subsets/releases; pin exact tasks, harness and verifier.

title: Agent Skills: A Data-Driven Analysis of Claude Skills for Extending Large Language Model Functionality
experiment_implication: Background for real skill-library composition and overlap.
limitation: An ecosystem analysis is not a retrieval method comparison.

title: SWE-Skills-Bench: Do Agent Skills Actually Help in Real-World Software Engineering?
experiment_implication: Optional software-engineering transfer benchmark.
limitation: Code execution, repository state and task costs add scope beyond discovery.

title: GraphSkill: Documentation-Guided Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Coding for Complex Graph Reasoning
experiment_implication: Background on hierarchical retrieval of procedural knowledge.
limitation: Domain-specific reasoning is not a plug-in replacement for SkillRet evaluation.

title: GraSP: Graph-Structured Skill Compositions for LLM Agents
experiment_implication: Background on graph-structured skill composition.
limitation: Composition labels and task execution require a separate experiment.

title: Maestro: Reinforcement Learning to Orchestrate Hierarchical Model-Skill Ensembles
experiment_implication: Background on learned model/skill orchestration.
limitation: Do not introduce reinforcement learning before cheaper discovery baselines are understood.

title: Skill is Not One-Size-Fits-All: Model-Aware Skill Alignment for LLM Agents
experiment_implication: Motivates checking whether the same retrieved skill helps different final LLMs.
limitation: Model-dependent utility is distinct from the fixed relevance labels.

title: Skill or Skip? Learning Selective Skill Invocation in Agentic Tasks via Dual-Granularity Preference Learning
experiment_implication: Related selective-invocation approach for an optional abstention study.
limitation: Needs genuine no-skill/utility labels; a candidate miss is not such a label.

title: SkillsInjector: Dynamic Skill Context Construction for LLM Agents
experiment_implication: Background for selecting which skill content to expose to the final model.
limitation: Context construction changes the evidence budget; measure it explicitly.

title: SkillNet: Create, Evaluate, and Connect AI Skills
experiment_implication: Related infrastructure for connected skill libraries.
limitation: Creating or modifying skills changes the corpus and belongs in a separate track.

title: Memento-Skills: Let Agents Design Agents
experiment_implication: Background on evolving skill-based agents.
limitation: Do not allow cross-test-query learning in a static retrieval benchmark.

title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching
experiment_implication: Keep in the literature map as an alternative to retrieving existing skills.
limitation: Generated skills cannot be scored as existing gold IDs without a new benchmark.

title: GraphSkillAA: Attribution-Guided Skill-Graph Updating with Targeted Validation and Rollback
experiment_implication: Background for validated graph updates and rollback.
limitation: Current primary title differs from the shorter SkillAA name in secondary indexing.

title: SkillSpec: Consensus-Gated Agent Skill Evolution via Representation Specialization
experiment_implication: Recent work on validated skill updates and flat/graph/hybrid representation choices.
limitation: Skill evolution is outside the fixed-corpus leaderboard track.

title: Chaining Skills to Hijack LLM Agents
experiment_implication: Motivates treating skill text as untrusted data and isolating downstream execution.
limitation: The core retrieval study should never execute retrieved skill instructions.

title: SkillReason: Reasoning-Enhanced Agent Skill Retrieval for Implicit User Requests
inspection_depth: abstract, selected methods/results, benchmark statistics and released interfaces inspected
experiment_implication: Test released 0.6B retrieval/reranking models first, optionally promote the 4B pair; use SkillReason-Bench as an independent implicit-query transfer benchmark. Compare training-time capability-reasoning transfer against inference-time query expansion.
limitation: The paper uses the older SkillRet pool (6,660 skills and 4,997 queries), so its claimed SOTA is not directly comparable to the corrected 6,006/4,392 benchmark. Audit training/test exposure per checkpoint.

title: Retrieval Models Aren't Tool-Savvy: Benchmarking Tool Retrieval for Large Language Models
experiment_implication: ToolRet provides a related external retrieval task.
limitation: API/tool selection and procedural SKILL.md retrieval are related, not identical.

title: Tools are under-documented: Simple Document Expansion Boosts Tool Retrieval
experiment_implication: Tool-REX suggests richer corpus-side capability descriptions.
limitation: Generated capabilities must be supported by the source; no gold-query-conditioned expansion.

title: ToolExpNet: Optimizing Multi-Tool Selection in LLMs with Similarity and Dependency-Aware Experience Networks
experiment_implication: Related dependency-aware multi-tool selection.
limitation: Experience graphs must be trained only on permitted past data.

title: Towards Completeness-Oriented Tool Retrieval for Large Language Models
experiment_implication: COLT motivates all-required-tools/skills completeness rather than first-hit metrics alone.
limitation: Tool co-occurrence may not transfer to unseen skill families.

title: Multi-Field Tool Retrieval
experiment_implication: Related evidence for preserving separate structured fields.
limitation: Reproduce the actual field method before claiming equivalence to an adapted BM25F design.

title: Reciprocal rank fusion outperforms condorcet and individual rank learning methods
experiment_implication: Use rank fusion as the simple lexical/dense combination control.
limitation: Fusion is not guaranteed to improve an already strong specialized retriever.

title: SPLADE v2: Sparse Lexical and Expansion Model for Information Retrieval
experiment_implication: Test learned sparse retrieval for complementary lexical/semantic recall.
limitation: Choose and pin an actual checkpoint and index settings; the paper is not the deployment artifact.

title: ColBERTv2: Effective and Efficient Retrieval via Lightweight Late Interaction
experiment_implication: Test token-level multi-vector matching versus one vector per skill.
limitation: Measure index size, document length policy and skill-level aggregation.

experiment_implication: BGE-M3 provides dense, sparse and multi-vector representation controls.
limitation: Do not label a single dense BGE-M3 run as a test of all three modes.

title: Qwen3 Embedding: Advancing Text Embedding and Reranking Through Foundation Models
experiment_implication: Use the base family to separate model size from task-specific fine-tuning.
limitation: Use the documented instructions, pooling, and yes/no reranker readout.

title: Is ChatGPT Good at Search? Investigating Large Language Models as Re-Ranking Agents
experiment_implication: RankGPT motivates listwise LLM reranking and later distillation.
limitation: Control order, output validity, candidate content, and token budget.

title: Large Language Models are Effective Text Rankers with Pairwise Ranking Prompting
experiment_implication: Pairwise comparisons are an alternative for a small ambiguous finalist set.
limitation: All-pairs calls scale quadratically; record actual comparisons and cycles.

title: RankZephyr: Effective and Robust Zero-Shot Listwise Reranking is a Breeze!
experiment_implication: Related training/distillation and rank_llm implementation reference.
limitation: Not a recommendation to run every older released ranker.

title: Late Chunking: Contextual Chunk Embeddings Using Long-Context Embedding Models
experiment_implication: Preserve context when indexing sections of long skill documents.
limitation: Requires an encoder/readout that supports the method; not every embedding API does.

title: Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels
experiment_implication: HyDE is an optional query-side generation control.
limitation: A generated hypothetical document can invent prerequisites; retain original query evidence.

title: jina-reranker-v3: Last but Not Late Interaction for Listwise Document Reranking
experiment_implication: Background on joint candidate attention without textual ranking generation.
limitation: This is not ColBERT-style separately indexed late interaction.

experiment_implication: Test a small joint listwise reranker against pointwise rerankers and JEV-like decisions.
